scenes.tts: In an asymmetric division, a radial glial cell keeps one daughter. What happens to the other one?
scenes.visual: Title card fades. A radial glial cell divides; one daughter stays, the other is marked with a question mark.
scenes.narration: In an asymmetric division, a radial glial cell keeps one daughter. What happens to the other one?

scenes.tts: It can take one of two routes. In direct neurogenesis, the radial glial cell divides into another radial glial cell and a neuron.
scenes.visual: Left lineage tree: radial glial parent to radial glial daughter plus one neuron. Label: direct.
scenes.narration: It can take one of two routes. In direct neurogenesis, the radial glial cell divides into another radial glial cell and a neuron.

scenes.tts: In indirect neurogenesis, the second daughter is an intermediate progenitor.
scenes.visual: Right lineage tree begins: radial glial daughter plus an intermediate progenitor. Label: indirect.
scenes.narration: In indirect neurogenesis, the second daughter is an intermediate progenitor.

scenes.tts: It lets go of the ventricle and moves into the subventricular zone. There it divides once more, in rodent cortex usually into two neurons.
scenes.visual: The intermediate progenitor detaches, rises into the SVZ and divides into two neurons.
scenes.narration: It lets go of the ventricle and moves into the subventricular zone. There it divides once more, in rodent cortex usually into two neurons.

scenes.tts: Filming rat slices, Noctor and colleagues tracked both routes. Most radial glial divisions were asymmetric.
scenes.visual: Both trees side by side. Tag: rat, embryonic day 16 to 19, Noctor and colleagues, 2004.
scenes.narration: Filming rat slices, Noctor and colleagues tracked both routes. Most radial glial divisions were asymmetric.

scenes.tts: About nine in ten intermediate progenitor divisions gave two neurons. But only nineteen divisions away from the ventricle were seen, so read it as rat.
scenes.visual: On screen: about 9 in 10 intermediate-progenitor divisions gave two neurons. Footnote: only 19 divisions away from the ventricle.
scenes.narration: About nine in ten intermediate progenitor divisions gave two neurons. But only 19 divisions away from the ventricle were seen, so read it as rat.
scenes.caption: About nine in ten intermediate progenitor divisions gave two neurons. But only 19 divisions away from the ventricle were seen, so read it as rat.

scenes.tts: In mouse, intermediate progenitors may make most cortical projection neurons.
scenes.visual: Mouse icon. Label: may make most projection neurons.
scenes.narration: In mouse, intermediate progenitors may make most cortical projection neurons.

scenes.tts: Transcription factors, proteins that switch genes on or off, mark the steps. Pax six marks radial glia. T B R two marks intermediate progenitors. T B R one marks young neurons.
scenes.caption: Transcription factors, proteins that switch genes on or off, mark the steps. Pax6 marks radial glia. Tbr2 marks intermediate progenitors. Tbr1 marks young neurons.
scenes.visual: The indirect tree recolours as cells move outward: Pax6 (radial glia), Tbr2 (intermediate progenitor), Tbr1 (neuron).
scenes.narration: Transcription factors, proteins that switch genes on or off, mark the steps. Pax6 marks radial glia. Tbr2 marks intermediate progenitors. Tbr1 marks young neurons.

scenes.tts: They appear in that order, as cells move outward.
scenes.visual: Arrow across the screen: Pax6 to Tbr2 to Tbr1.
scenes.narration: They appear in that order, as cells move outward.

scenes.tts: But are the markers only labels? In two thousand eight, two groups removed T B R two from the developing mouse brain.
scenes.caption: But are the markers only labels? In 2008, two groups removed Tbr2 from the developing mouse brain.
scenes.visual: Tbr2 is struck out. Tag: Arnold and colleagues; Sessa and colleagues, 2008.
scenes.narration: But are the markers only labels? In 2008, two groups removed Tbr2 from the developing mouse brain.

scenes.tts: Count mitoses at the ventricle, and away from it. If T B R two is a step in the indirect route, which count should fall?
scenes.caption: Count mitoses at the ventricle, and away from it. If Tbr2 is a step in the indirect route, which count should fall?
scenes.visual: Two counters: mitoses at the ventricle, mitoses away from it. Both show question marks.
scenes.narration: Count mitoses at the ventricle, and away from it. If Tbr2 is a step in the indirect route, which count should fall?

scenes.tts: Division at the ventricle went on. Division away from it fell. And fewer cortical neurons were made.
scenes.visual: Counter at the ventricle holds steady; counter away from it drops. Below, a smaller pile of neurons.
scenes.narration: Division at the ventricle went on. Division away from it fell. And fewer cortical neurons were made.

scenes.tts: The position of mitosis, read with the markers, pointed to the lost progenitor. In those mice, T B R two was needed for the indirect route.
scenes.caption: The position of mitosis, read with the markers, pointed to the lost progenitor. In those mice, Tbr2 was needed for the indirect route.
scenes.visual: Callback to the lift: position is a clue, markers confirm. Label: Tbr2 needed for the indirect route (2008 mutants).
scenes.narration: The position of mitosis, read with the markers, pointed to the lost progenitor. In those mice, Tbr2 was needed for the indirect route.

scenes.tts: Primates have a third progenitor in far greater numbers. Outer radial glia divide far from the ventricle. Mouse has a few. Humans have far more.
scenes.visual: A thicker primate wall: many outer radial glia dividing far above the ventricle. Small inset: mouse with a few.
scenes.narration: Primates have a third progenitor in far greater numbers. Outer radial glia divide far from the ventricle. Mouse has a few. Humans have far more.

scenes.tts: Now, what does a leaving daughter give up? A niche is the local setting that keeps a stem cell a stem cell.
scenes.visual: Zoom to one radial glial cell spanning ventricle to basement membrane. Label: niche.
scenes.narration: Now, what does a leaving daughter give up? A niche is the local setting that keeps a stem cell a stem cell.

scenes.tts: The apical foot faces the cerebrospinal fluid. In mouse, that fluid carries growth factors, among them I G F two, that support proliferation.
scenes.caption: The apical foot faces the cerebrospinal fluid. In mouse, that fluid carries growth factors, among them IGF2, that support proliferation.
scenes.visual: Gold dots in the fluid near the apical foot, labelled growth factors, including IGF2.
scenes.narration: The apical foot faces the cerebrospinal fluid. In mouse, that fluid carries growth factors, among them IGF2, that support proliferation.

scenes.tts: The basal foot rests on the basement membrane under the pia. Neighbouring cells, through Notch, are part of the setting too.
scenes.visual: The basal foot on the basement membrane lights up. Neighbour cells show small Notch contacts.
scenes.narration: The basal foot rests on the basement membrane under the pia. Neighbouring cells, through Notch, are part of the setting too.

scenes.tts: In an asymmetric division, the daughter that leaves lets go of the apical surface. It gives up the fluid side of the niche, and its growth signals.
scenes.visual: A daughter detaches from the ventricle and moves away; the gold dots stay behind.
scenes.narration: In an asymmetric division, the daughter that leaves lets go of the apical surface. It gives up the fluid side of the niche, and its growth signals.

scenes.tts: The daughter that stays keeps it.
scenes.visual: The remaining radial glial cell keeps its apical foot in the fluid.
scenes.narration: The daughter that stays keeps it.

scenes.tts: Losing apical contact goes with leaving, but it is not the same thing. An intermediate progenitor has let go, and still divides once more.
scenes.visual: The detached intermediate progenitor divides once more in the SVZ.
scenes.narration: Losing apical contact goes with leaving, but it is not the same thing. An intermediate progenitor has let go, and still divides once more.

scenes.tts: So a spent daughter makes one neuron directly, or usually two through an intermediate progenitor. Follow its markers and divisions to tell which.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: one neuron, or usually two through an intermediate progenitor; markers and divisions tell you which.
scenes.narration: So a spent daughter makes one neuron directly, or usually two through an intermediate progenitor. Follow its markers and divisions to tell which.
